title: Dresden Striezelmarkt 2026 official city information

facts.fact: The 2026 Striezelmarkt at Altmarkt runs 25 November to 24 December.
Opening day is 16–21 and Christmas Eve 10–14; regular days 10–21.
facts.excerpt: 25 November (opening): 4 pm to 9 pm26 November to 23 December: daily 10 am to 9 pm24 December: 10 am to 2 pm

facts.fact: Market focuses on Saxon and Ore Mountain crafts and Dresden stollen.
facts.excerpt: Ore Mountain handicrafts and the famous Dresdner Christstollen

notes: Relevant source passages read on 2026-11-01; only recorded facts used. Regional tourism overview has inconsistent Striezelmarkt dates; use city organizer dates here.
